partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Mouse-phenotype-supported GOF suppression
results.hypothesis: Direct inhibition of a gain-of-function disease gene is more credible when its mouse ortholog reproduces an exact phenotype of the human disease.
results.body: drug binds and decreases Gene2Phenotype GOF gene whose mouse ortholog shares an exact disease phenotype
results.mechanism_rationale: Drug direction opposes explicit disease variant direction, while orthology and exact model phenotype independently support the gene-disease mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: The positive graph and direction qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; source, taxon, variant-form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (human_gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(human_gene)
MATCH (human_gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (human_gene)-[:ORTHOLOGOUS_TO]-(mouse_gene:Gene)
      -[model_evidence:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
      <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND 'NCBITaxon:9606' IN coalesce(human_gene.in_taxon, [])
  AND 'NCBITaxon:10090' IN coalesce(mouse_gene.in_taxon, [])
  AND 'infores:mgi' IN
      coalesce(model_evidence.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
